newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no power for peak hours on Tues.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no power for peak hours on Tues.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no power during peak demand hours on Tuesday, but left prices for off-peak hours unchanged, the agency said Monday.
Prices for firm off-peak power (hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) were flat at $9.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for all deliveries.
Prices for non-firm power during off-peak hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were also unchanged at $9.00.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600-0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300) offers were steady at $10.00 for Northwest and $11.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Tuesday at $7.00 per MWh for all deliveries and at $5.00 for Northwest buyers only.
